# Repository defaults reference

The repository defaults file, `gateway.yaml`, at the root of a repository of APIs: defaults every overlay file can override. Not the gateway's own configuration file, also called `gateway.yaml` by its README; see the words and names rule of the documentation spec, section 9. Generated from its JSON Schema.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `defaults` | object |  |
| `defaults.char` | object |  |
| `defaults.char.pad` | left or right |  |
| `defaults.char.padChar` | string |  |
| `defaults.char.nullAs` | string |  |
| `defaults.inputoutput` | both or fail |  |
| `defaults.largeArrayThreshold` | integer | A fixed output array of at least this many elements without trim is reported (OVL005). Default 100. |
| `defaults.maxResponseValues` | integer | The largest number of scalar values a response may hold after trimming. Default 100000. |
| `emitters` | array |  |

Repository-wide defaults only. Every key is optional.

## Complete example

```yaml
defaults:
  char:
    pad: left
    padChar: "0"
    nullAs: ""
  inputoutput: fail
  largeArrayThreshold: 100
  maxResponseValues: 100000
emitters:
  - descriptor
  - openapi
  - mock
```
